1.title: Your Voice Agent is Just a Walkie Talkie — Neil Zeghidour, Gradium
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Full duplex voice agents require modeling two simultaneous token streams; the tradeoff is naturalness vs reasoning capacity within a fixed model weight budget.

1.title: How I Automated 90% of My Content Workflow (With ChatGPT)
1.author: Peter Yang
1.hook: Built 8 specific AI skills (guest research, interview prep, editor briefs, newsletter writing, video packaging, social scheduling) connected into a single workflow that saves 5 hours/week.

2.title: Muse gets AI agent UX right
2.author: How I AI
2.hook: First-pass test of Meta's Muse personal agent across real workflows (calendar, newsletters, goals, shopping, avatar), with specific design patterns identified (permission model, activity feed, browser use limitations).

3.title: Pinecone 2.0 — Edo Liberty, Pinecone
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Enterprise agents need a persistent knowledge layer that surfaces tribal knowledge (how things actually get done), not just retrieval over documents — and the implementation cuts tooling prompts from 150k tokens to under 1k by using runtime code generation.

4.title: The unreasonable effectiveness of BM25 for agentic search — Jo Kristian Bergum, Hornet.dev
4.author: AI Engineer
4.hook: BM25 (a 30-year-old lexical search function) is resurging because agents formulate longer, more specific queries than humans — and a benchmark of 830 questions shows retrieval quality, not reasoning, is the bottleneck.

1.title: Connect AI to Billions of Legal Documents — Simon Eskildsen, turbopuffer & Jacob Lauritzen, Legora
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: How namespace-per-project storage architecture solved a cache-thrashing problem that pushed search latency from 100ms to 20 seconds, and why that shape unlocks encryption/isolation for regulated customers.

2.title: Stop Chunking Like It's 2022 — Yuval Belfer, AI21 Labs
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Indexing the same corpus at multiple chunk sizes and merging rankings by reciprocal rank fusion closes a 20–40% recall gap that fixed chunking has been silently costing.

3.title: Where RL Will Take Search — Maximilian-David Rumpf, SID.ai
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: RL applied to agentic search can reduce latency 20× and cost 100× versus frontier models by learning a reward function where success is verifiable (document found or not).
